name: Bevy
description: A data-driven game engine built in Rust.
summary: Bevy bans AI-generated media, AI-written documentation, issues, PR descriptions and release notes, AI-pasted conversation replies, and AI commit authorship. AI assistance is tolerated in some code-related areas only when it is disclosed and the contributor personally understands and can justify every submitted line, and reviewers may decline or close AI-assisted work.

evidence.quote: We are wary of the use of AI in the development of Bevy, and are particularly troubled by its impact on artists, but tolerate careful human-driven AI use in some code-related areas consistent with the above values.

As a contributor, you are responsible for everything you submit. You must personally understand every line of code or documentation that you put forward for review, and be able to articulate the design rationale and implementation tradeoffs when asked.
Any use of AI to contribute to Bevy must be disclosed, with context about how it was used.
AI-assisted PRs will be held to the same rigorous standard of review: correctness, tests, rationale, incremental reviewable units, appropriate design and consensus building and so on.
AI must not be used to write public-facing prose, including documentation, issues, PR descriptions, or release notes.

Images, 3d models, audio assets (and so on) submitted to Bevy may not be authored or modified with the use of generative AI tools. Use a permissively licensed asset, make one by hand, or commission an artist.
Only humans can be commit authors or listed as Co-authored-by.
AI must not be used to write public-facing prose, including documentation, issues, PR descriptions, or release notes.
AI must not be used to write public-facing prose, including documentation, issues, PR descriptions, or release notes.
Only humans can be commit authors or listed as Co-authored-by.
Do not paste AI-generated output directly into conversations with humans, no matter where they take place.
AI may be used to assist for translation and accessibility purposes, but please include the original untranslated text as well.

Individual reviewers are empowered to request changes to contributions that fail to live up to these norms, or in cases where the work is not salvageable (commonly due to a lack of understanding by the original author), close them completely.

otherRules.description: Harassment, pressure or belittling of others over their use of, abstinence from or views on AI is not tolerated, and repeated or severe violations may lead to warnings, suspensions or bans.

quotes.quote: Do not harass, demean, pressure, or bully others. This continues to apply, even when the basis of your disagreement centers around use of, abstinence from or views on AI.

otherRules.description: Discussion of personal AI tools and practices should be kept to the #ai-tools Discord channel, and engine-related discussion of adopting or abandoning AI workflows should be threaded.

quotes.quote: note that discussion of personal AI-related tools and practices should be contained to the #ai-tools channel on Discord to ensure others can easily avoid these discussions.
engine-related conversation on adoption or abandonment of AI workflows should similarly be threaded.

referencedPolicies.note: The policy states that Bevy's Code of Conduct continues to apply when AI-related topics are discussed, including rules against harassment and disruptive debate.
